summary: Hope can not end Hate. Hope: empty vessel of Infinite Jest echoing loud sounds of hate Only filled with love's new dawn, an ent-draft for our collective soul, Can hope quench the undying thirst of hate #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Hope can
  not end
Hate.

Hope:
  empty
vessel
  of
Infinite Jest
echoing
loud
sounds
of hate

Only filled
with love's
 new dawn,
an ent-draft
for our collective
soul,
Can hope quench
  the undying
thirst of hate
#smallpoems
